# Playwright Framework from Scratch

## Framework Overview

```text
Playwright Framework
│
├── POM
├── Components
├── Fixtures
├── Authentication
├── Reporting
├── CI/CD
├── Docker
├── Parallel Execution
├── Test Data
├── Environment Config
├── Logging
├── Retry Strategy
├── Framework Architecture
├── Folder Structure
├── Execution Strategy
└── Scalability
```

## Must-Haves

- UI Tests
- API Tests
- Login once, save auth state, reuse auth state
- Hybrid Tests
- POM + Design pattern
- Fixtures
- Authentication
- Sessions
- Test Data Management
- Reporting
- GitHub Actions CI/CD
- Docker
- Git
- Parallel Execution
- Cross Browser
- Performance test suite in the same framework
- Environment-wise configuration

- Login
- Search

- Forms
